registryBasis: The official Olongapo City Government Directory lists a City Assessor's Office. The official City Citizens Charter documents GIS Map Acquisition by the City Planning and Development Office and a GIS/lot-map service procedure. DENR-LMB FOI records evidence Olongapo cadastral map requests, including TS-308 Cadastre and Cadastral Lot 1226 D. These establish local/national registry custodianship, not open citywide parcel integration.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: First-party content was independently identified in search results; direct fetch was access-denied, so no page/API configuration was inferred from the failed request.
Current public viewer HTML fetched; JavaScript modules and public layer endpoints were inspected.
Public layer catalog returned LMB Parcel data, layer_name denr_parcel_data, style ParcelData; no Olongapo scope was stated in the catalog entry.
Layer config returned native fields ogc_fid, wkb_geometry, lotnumber, shape_length, shape_area and metadata naming selected Metro Manila areas. No feature attributes were retained.
Metadata states vector parcel data for selected areas in Metro Manila; geographic bounds 120.93509325335022..121.10081445696459 longitude and 14.524359294990173..14.686954753799442 latitude.
Published service extent in EPSG:3857 was returned; it is consistent with Metro Manila and does not cover the preserved Olongapo point.
Current capabilities identify denr_parcel_data as queryable, EPSG:3857, with LatLonBoundingBox 120.93509325335022..121.10081445696459 and 14.524359294990173..14.686954753799442.

Bounded anonymous query at the exact preserved WUP point's surrounding bbox returned an empty FeatureCollection. This is recorded as an extent miss for the published Metro Manila layer, not evidence of Olongapo-wide absence.
Public lot-plotter location endpoint was authorization-gated; no login or bypass was attempted.
Lot plotter page fetched; its current JS shows survey bearing/distance and CSV plotting workflows, not parcel lookup coverage.

blocker: The only live public parcel service found is an LMB GeoServer WMS layer explicitly scoped to selected Metro Manila areas; no Olongapo-scoped anonymous ID-plus-geometry response or citywide open coverage was qualified.
remainingUncertainty: Olongapo's local assessor/planning offices and DENR-LMB hold cadastral/map workflows, and request-based Olongapo cadastral records exist, but the current public machine-readable parcel service and stable native identity semantics for Olongapo remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
nextStep: A future attempt should inspect any newly published Olongapo/LMB service or documented downloadable geometry and request only safe native ID plus polygon geometry near the saved point.
